## Flow (reported, not gated)

No finding comes from this section (P1 of the private research note video-learnings-2026-10.md). Ready is the story's first `status:ready` label; the first checkpoint is the earliest in `build/<n>/state.json` on the ledger; gate green is when the first successful `aayudha-merge-gate.yml` run on the merged head completed; ship is the merge. A stage counts only the stories that have both of its ends.

Touches: comments and reviews by a person on the story or its merge PR between Ready and ship (not a bot, not a comment carrying an aayudha marker, and not the approving review, which is ship's human pass), each later `status:ready`, and the PR's WP5.7 corrections other than a changes-requested review. In solo mode an agent writing as the founder without a marker counts as a person.

**inspect advice acted on:** 81 % (25 of 31 posted findings). inspect reviewed 66 of the 67 PRs merged in the window, with 32 fix cycles; 14 recorded posted findings: 25 acted on (gone from the latest inspection), 3 dismissed by a person, 3 open at merge.

**Escape rate:** 36 % (19 of 53 stories): a Bug opened after the story merged and within `[autonomy] correction_days` (14), whose body links the story or its merge PR, and which that PR does not itself fix.

**Change mix** (Conventional Commit type of the 67 PRs merged into dev in the window): fix 37 (55 %), feat 24 (36 %), chore 4 (6 %), docs 1 (1 %), test 1 (1 %).

## Fix layer of Feedback

Every Feedback issue opened before the cursor, by the highest layer that can fix its correction for good (ETHOS 10): a codebase or static-check correction becomes a Story, only a prose one goes to `aayu evolve`, and a review one changes what is surfaced for review. The layer is a judgement recorded with `aayu retro --classify`. Fix Stories carry the same `fix:<layer>` label; shipped means delivered by the cursor.
